review_text: Dr. Zhong is a really good chemistry teacher. She taught the concepts really but you still have to self study if you want that A. Her redemption system helps so don\'t get discouraged if you do bad on the first midterm. Try and and have upward trend in grades. I got a C on the first midterm but showed improvement later on and got an A in the class.

I have her for behav. neuro and she is terrible at explaining. Shows us almost irrelevant videos and doesn\'t understand questions asked. Very vague with concepts - students have to explain to other students about the material. Has an annoying and nervous habit... do switch out if you get her.

the prof. is real crap. it is a shame that the university hires such profs.....he diesnt even know how to teach. he comes up in class and says that he\'s not the kind of professor who teaches everything. personally it is a waste of money if you are taking class from him. he is the most useless and worthless professor i have seen in my entire life!!!

He is a great guy and is pretty funny in class. Lectures get boring and you use all your books. However, even though you read his quizzes in seminar are impossible because the questions are on minuscule details.
Plain and simple, this guy is HORRIBLE! He not only insults the students he teaches, but he doesn\'t know how to teach his classes. Ugh... Dr. Rashid is pretty bad, but he\'s better than this guy!

I had this teacher last semester and it was one of my best classes. He will make you laugh and help you when you need it. He is hard on grading the work. He could be my father but whoa for the age he has the looks. i will take another a class with him next year in the spring.

He expects you to have a graduate school level understanding of EVERY process. You know the little footnotes at the bottom of the textbook that are size 2 font? Well, he will pull questions from those and expect you to know things you can\'t possible know. He doesn\'t hit on any key points in lecture; he just powers through 100 slides each class.
She is cool, but she keeps us to the minute and once she starts talking, she goes on tangents for days. Otherwise, shes alright.

Joe is awesome! He is extremely helpful and is in the Math Lab often. He wants you to understand the material. Plenty of extra credit. He is inspirational every morning. I wish I could have him for all my math classes. TAKE JOE! WARNING: he seems grumpy at first but has a huge heart. Just work hard and show it. You can\'t get any better than Joe!
Cheryl is AWESOME!!!!!
Great instructor, he wants you to learn for yourselves.

THe CHILLEST professor i\'ve ever had! His class is fun depending on who you sit with because the people you sit with are the people u will be working with. Test are easy and 90% of the work is in groups. If u ask for help he gives u the answer pretty much.Over all he is a very chill dude and so is the class!
This teacher is awesome! Very enjoyable class. He is funny! Attendance was not mandatory but You do not wanna miss any of his interesting classes.

His lectures are interesting and encourage you to look at literature in a different way, though it is abstract at times. He is very particular with grammar and his quizzes tend to have a few obscure questions that tend to throw people off. As long as you do every reading and answer the study guide questions, you\'ll do well in the class.

One of the nicest guys on campus! Very passionate about the course. Do the readings! He lectures off the book and does adds information that will be on tests so don\'t miss class either. The subject is not as exciting as you would think but he keeps it interesting with his personal stories.

THIS GUY IS GREAT!! He makes class fun and participation counts for part of your grade. If you read what he tells yo to, do the homework, and come to class prepared you should have no problem passing this class. GREAT GREAT TEACHER!!

I took her class during the summer and we ended up doing yoga for a little over an hour four days straight and I loved it! She\'s clear and concise about the poses! Her grading is not hard at all! You show up and you will get an A! She doesn\'t expect much! You show her respect and she will reflect it back. She\'s sweet and a delight to around.

Constructive criticism can be very helpful in a legal writing course. However, don\'t expect to get any of that in Chesler\'s class. She is spiteful, rude, and condescending. She goes out of her way to intentionally confuse and mislead her students. Her lectures are absolutely worthless; she uses them as an opportunity to hear herself speak.

Manny is an awesome teacher. Is ALWAYS down to help you with any questions you have. Made my 102 class funny and fun actually looked forward to attending it. Will go over things as many times as you want if you dont understand it. He wants you to do good in the class. I would def take him and ask questions in class or office hours very helpful!!!

guys! the dude before me sucks-all lies. Dr. Li is very helpful he cares about his students, asks and remembers any detail u tell him! he writes rec letters trutfully.I enjoyed his classes and never thought they were boring. If you attend the lectures, no texbook is required! you learn what u need to learn! He is my favorite BE professor!
Good Teacher. Cares!... and that\'s not very common these days.
This is a management class and he goes on and on giving environmental statistics. He is an extremely tough marker.

THE BEST TEACHER AT CTU ONLINE PERIOD. i am almost done with my BSBA so it has been a while since i have had him for a teacher, but his lessons stick with me to the day. he has prepared me for classes at higher levels, and is truely concerned about the students, and their performance. i will stop here , because 350 characters is just not enough.
Very heavy bookwork and the material is very difficult. His teaching style is kinda all over the place, but he\'s really awesome about curving the tests and offering up extra credit.

This lady is SO MEAN. I dread going to this class because it is awkward and everyone can\'t stand her. The class readings are hard, she covers way too much too fast, and she is really impatient. It would be ok if it was hard and she was nice, but it is a hard class with no payoff since she is so mean. Future students: Don\'t take her!

She\'s nice and approachable, but also knows her stuff. The readings, screenings, and paper topics are interesting and good for both RHCS-majors and gen electives. Class is heavily discussion based, with her serving as a moderator/agenda setter, which occasionally gets repetitive. Not hard to succeed, but put in the work and you will learn as well.

Narcisa is a fantastic instructor. Her explanations on skills and rationale in clinical are spot on. She spends most of her time during clinical seeking out skill opportunities for her students and bends over backwards to promote our learning experience. If you know where to access information and convey confidence, you will learn & grow a lot.

Definitely my favourite prof, really cares about his students academics and is ALWAYS available for help. Professor Nilges also provides a lot of positive criticism if you do go to see him during office hours. My writing skills improved a lot this year because of him as well.

This class was very difficult, but he told you exactly what was expected in order to succeed. He also provided a ton of additional help. He is a great teacher, but you have to be willing to work hard.
Mr. Kevin Powers was a sub once for Jay Miller\'s class. I learned more from Kevin then I ever did Jay. Fantastic teacher!!

Dr. Kusina was the best professor I\'ve ever had. You must come to class, have a good attitude with a respect for others\' opinions, pay attention, and do assignments on time. She makes classes extremely interesting and relevant. Would take her for any class that I can.

Professor Tryhane is a awesome professor. He knows a lot about business and working in corporate America. What most most helpful about this class was that he teaches you how to write a resume and helps you make a plan for reaching your education and career goals. Professor Tryhane\'s class was a welcomed relief from my harder classes.

Very fun class. You\'ll learn a lot; not just about defending yourself but feeling confident in yourself, too. Attendance is mandatory. A man will come in for the final to perform an attack on each student and you\'ll have to properly fight back. It\'s really easy. Such a great class!

Angela was super helpful and would often go off topic to answer students questions or give tips for our terrible placements. She had many different teaching strategies. She would lecture, do group activities, bring candy. She even suggested the whole class wear pj\'s to class one night. She would teach until 9, but time would fly.

No textbook but there are notes and the assignments are found on the course website. She expects you to either print out the story or to bring your laptop to read from. She wants you to learn how to close read. Two papers. Midterm paper is a traditional one. The final one is what you are interested. Always available for you. Wants the best for you.

Professor has no idea what he is doing. Grades are arbitrary with the requirements usually unknown. Expect to lose a LOT of points for no reason. Nothing well explained, only some of notes posted. Textbook is used once, borrow from someone who did get it

I thought she did great. The PP slides just mean you don\'t have to write notes yourself. She is a joy to have as a teacher if you PARTICIPATE and SHOW UP TO CLASS!!! People who **** are the ones who never show up. She can be very funny & I enjoyed this class very much.

OK Professor. Tests are pretty easy but the two major assignments she has you do are graded ridiculously. She is not clear about what she is looking for. Do not take the class if you want your grade to accurately reflect what you learned and put into the class.
Professor goel is awesome. She is very clear with the material and gives wicked good review sheets before each test.

I\'ve had Quarterman for 2 years now. His class is probably the most entertaining class I\'ve had at Howard. He always seems to have an amazing story about his life and its relation to whatever we may be discussing at the time. His class is more of a lecture but once every week we are required to complete an assignment. He is Joy! take this class!
you have to do 10 one page movie assignments and your regular 80 question test midterm final all that good stuff. He tells the same stories and is kinda rude and a ****. Not approachable at all.

nice person, but just not a good low level math teacher. she has a phd in physics so shes incredibly smart but she teaches 1150 as if it\'s a physics class. and her accent is super thick and its hard to understand her. she gets caught up on one concept because one person doesn\'t get it and then runs out of time and leaves several things uncovered.

Easiest professor at UCSB and the easiest class I\'ve taken since elementary school. Awesome old guy with great stories and a hilarious laugh. Tons of extra credit and class never went the full length. Take him if you want a laidback quarter.

Mortea Barshool is very funny, make the math class very interesting. He told story to help us remember formula. Tests are not hard, very clear. The final covers all the 3 tests we took before. Extral 2 point makes the different between A and B. Excellent teacher!

NO reason why people should not do well. She completely prepares you for the tests, holds study sessions, and even let us make "cheat sheet" for the exams. She gave us her cell # in case we needed to call for extra help. There were people in my class that never came, didnt do HW and then wondered why they were failing. You have actually try people!

Tests are take home. Super easy class. It\'s only four of them with the last one required if you don\'t have an A in the class. You can get answers for the tests even from the powerpoints that you print out. Gives quite a few extra credit opportunities. Awesome class!

Best science teacher I\'ve had. Really cares about her students. More than willing to spend extra time with you after class, in lab, or at office hours to ensure you understand the material. Exams are directly from the notes & she gives a lot of opportunities for extra credit. Tells you what to expect on exams. Very enthusiastic. Highly recommend!

I had art drawing with claire.. she may noy have the most vivid and fun personality but shes pretty helpful and taught me alot. I really enjoyed viewing every ones work and talking about our art. Attendence is mandatory but it didnt bother me because she rarely gave us homework.

He was is tough grader and generous. Overall even though he is generous. He is very bad at explaining to students. He doesnt like you if you ask too many questions. He gets upset if you do. He is nice person but not enough for a student to pass his class. He only gives midterm and final exam. If you fail in one of them. You failed the whole class.
GREAT PROFESSOR. KNOWS HIS STUFF. CLASS ONE DAY..GYM WORKOUTS THE OTHER. TWO TAKE HOME TESTS..ONE RESEARCH PAPER.. EASY FINAL. GUARANTEED A IN HIS CLASS. VERY HELPFUL!! I RECOMMEND!!

The grade was based on 4 quizzes that you could pass if you read through the module that was posted online. If you did any extra credit, it was an easy 4.0. He tended to talk about the same few points over and over and was not open to opinions that opposed his. He leans liberal and is very anti-gun and brought up points that didn\'t have relevance.
I only did well in the course because I have taken chemistry before. He was confusing in his explanations. To top it all off, he was 50 minutes late to the final!!! Totally unprofessional.

I have a bio degree from a \'most competitive\' rated school; I had to take A&P I & II because they didn\'t transfer after 10 years. I took A&P II with Prof. Keenan. He is undoubtedly one of THE best professors I have ever had. Driven & enthusiastic; he does all he can you help you learn a TON of material. NOT EASY! STUDY or FAIL! Simple as that!

she is the best professor I have ever had in Baruch. She is the motivation for me to come to class in Saturday morning! she always show funny videos in class to wake us up! 1Midterm, 1Final, 1Paper will extra credit that worth 10points on your Midterm. Exams are easy, she will tell you which from the ppt will be on the test. easy A!
Avoid him!

She focused more on earning her own degree than helping us earn ours. She teaches this introductory course as if it were an upper level philosophy class. Sometimes she does not even have a lecture ready. She takes roll every day and her tests are hard even if you really study. Don\'t recommend taking this professor.
Would not recommend. Class was very easy, but did not enjoy the busy work that seemed pointless .
Great instructor. Make sure you study whats on syllabus.

Hermana Hamblin is a really good teacher. She really cares about her students, and she always trying to come up with new ways to teach. She is an excellent teacher for those who are first learning how to speak Spanish. I highly recommend Hermana Hamblin!

Todd is extremely boring and talks a lot off topic. He doesn\'t answer his emails so don\'t even bother there. I\'m in his class right now and its incredibly boring, I wish I\'d taken an online class. You have to do A LOT of reading in the book- They say I say, and the readings are really long..So far I wouldn\'t recommend him.

She is absolutely the BEST professor I ever had! IF you have the chance please take her. She is very inspirational and her lectures are very fun. She will give you a book you can buy off Amazon instead of the pricey ones from the book store. I would definitely take another class with her.
Shes very good at teaching but she talks to much she may bore you

She is horrible!! do not recommend taking this class with her. I took it online. I was an accelerated course so it was a lot of work. But if for some reason you need some help or an emergency happens and you need more time to submit your work, she will not help!!

Amazing Prof if you are interested in Marketing as a career path. She makes lessons extremely enjoyable and interesting. Tests are a little tough but very fair and exactly what she includes in her "checkmark" slides and some textbook terms. She knows her stuff and teaches in a way thay makes you remember concepts easily! Print slides before class.
He is amazing!
she\'s dreamy

It felt like a bad high school class all over again- she made us come to class even when she had nothing for us to do and NEVER let us go a second before time was over... She is lenient on papers and will help, but don\'t email her because she will never email you back. I made A\'s on most of my papers, but she is a hard grader.
I love this guy. Absolutely hilarious, class was FUN. Nothing extraordinary on HW\'s or exams. Would love to take another of his classes.
His a great teacher. He go over anything you don\'t understand.
I wish I could take this class again for the first time. Fenske keeps a brisk pace in his lectures, so come to class and pay attention. Still, probably the best class I took in my undergrad.

Jane is the best. She has high energy levels, sometimes too high for 9 in the morning. She gives a lot of freedom on the assignments so its good if you like that. Attendance is mandatory, but if you have a good excuse you\'re fine.

John is funny & friendly, laid-back, and acts more like a young uncle than an authority figure. really knowledgeable, offers lots of good critique and is more than willing to go out of his way to help students with whatever they need. But he\'s a tough grader, for no apparent reason.

I love her! she is definitely the best professor at avc. She is amazing at math and is willing to help anyone who needs help! I wish she was teaching the upper divisions classes! I would recommend her t anyone.

This instructor would rather complete the syllabus on schedule and have one-forth or less of the beginning class at the end of the semester than slow down, teach and reach down to the student\'s level of understanding. GET A TUTOR, TEXTBOOK AND THE SOFTWARE EARLY TO PREP FOR HER! Don\'t be afraid to ask questions in class or she will ZOOOOOM off...

His lectures are so clear and the tests were VERY manageable. He gave us two practice tests and 2 pages of notes to bring into the final. He doesnt care that you memorize the material as long as you can apply your knowledge. I would take ANY math class from him and I wish he worked at UCSD full-time. I was so blessed to have him while he was here.

There are 4 quizzes, 4 hw assignments, midterm and final She offers a 20 pt extra cr towards the end of semester. Very understanding and wants her students to really understand the course. If your not serious about class she notices and will drop you. Not mean but doesnt put up w/ interruptions Take her you\'ll be happy you did in the end!!

Professor Isaacson\'s class was challenging but overall she did an amazing job teaching this GER course. The schedule for this course was extremely organized and helpful. You really have to make an effort to do well but it\'s possible if you get everything done on time and participate.

No, Ms. Fabian will not spoon-feed you; this does not mean she\'s a bad professor. She\'s very knowledgeable. If you\'re confused, see her during office hours- this is college. Fast-paced, provides fun examples that help things stick, always willing to talk 1-on-1. Incredible teacher. Not recommended for poor students.
If you\'re interested in seriously pursuing French I\'d recommend her. She\'s tough but fair, and pretty nice. She lived in France for 7 years and is a translator so she knows her stuff.

Very smart guy, super interesting and captivating lectures. Best teacher I\'ve had at Indiana University. Not an easy class; I recommend going to all lectures if you can, but it\'s totally worth it. Nice, understanding guy too. Also, fricking HILARIOUS and kinda crazy in a good way.
She\'s a new professor at CRC so I can\'t rate her at the moment. She\'s nice, helpful and easy to talk to.

I didn\'t enjoy his class and I felt like the material he brought up during lecture was irrelevant to the course mostly. I would have much rather stuck to the topic of journalism outlets oppose to viral videos and stuff like that. The assignments weren\'t very structured and he was hard to reach for help.

Shes awesome! Very helpful and wants you to pass. Gives extra credit and literally gives a step by step on how to get an A in the class and even holds your hand and walks you through it! You CANNOT fail with her!
Easiest speech class ever. The longest speech is 8 minutes and its in a group of 4. If you have an A going into the final you don\'t have to take it. She gives you candy
Nice Teacher
The course material wasn\'t easy, but he made it doable. Very clearer, and knowledgeable. Fair exams and he graded pretty easy. Lab was fun. Really good class if u want to know IC engine.
Did they have the same guy...he tells the same stories over and over. (in a monotone voice)

Never knows what he wants from you! He\'ll give you the most unfair grades, even when you answer the questions right. Do NOT take this guy unless you\'re an electrical engineer. He makes it impossible for newbies to learn the material.
The best professor that I\'ve ever had! He\'s Great! I\'d recommend him to anyone!
Really great teacher. You either know it or you dont kind of class. Raw humor, pretty funny guy

AWSOME!!!! WHEN I HAD HER SHE TOOK US TO THE COURTS IN BROWARD COUNTY, WE ALL GOT TO MEET WITH HER FRIEND "HELP ME HOWARD" AT HIS OFFICE. VERY CLEAR, UNDERSTANDING, AND COOL TEACHER. HER CLASS CONSISTS OF DEFINITIONS, BRIEFING CASES, AND AN EASY MIDTERM AND FINAL. JUST PAY ATTENTION AND YOU WILL BE FINE! JUST MAKE SURE YOU READ BOOK BEFORE CLASS.

Mr. Downey is an awesome and funny teacher. He will keep you the whole class, but the way he teaches is outstanding, and learned a lot from this class. Only 2 essays and two tests the whole class, and wont even use your book, all you need is the notes. Highly recommended! Best teacher at brookdale!
friggin GENIUS! too bad the automotive dean is such a B***H cause we lost a great one with him!

Shes amazing!! Easily approachable and super organized! You will always know your grade in the class. Tons of preparation for tests and TONS of extra credit! Very caring and she will work with you to help you pass! She wont just give you the grade. You do have to study and do the homework but if you stay on top of everything, youre golden!
Ms. Bratton is a great teacher, she is very soft spoken though.(lol) She is always helpful and she makes you feel like you can do anything when it comes to math. I will give her an A+++
She often seems angry and upset and don\'t have a sense of humor. Her exams are difficult, and you don\'t know what issues of an essay will be worth the most. Avoid taking her if possible.

Great prof, loved him! Hilarious and very intelligent. I did well on multiple choice by just doing the quizzes and flashcards on the online resource he gave. The short answers are based on additional articles and course content but they aren\'t worth that much and he explicitly tells you in class what to focus on. He is helpful if you seek help.

I really Wish that professor Watson would get on her and review the commentary regarding her teaching style. She is by far the worst teacher that i have ever had. I even scored a B in the final of the class. The only thing that helped me understand the materials were the recitations taught by grad students. She is aweful!!!
Great Teacher wish he though all my classes
International SW -great profe ssor; knowledgeable; experienced; passionate; has heavy accent, but easy to understand if one wants to learn; willing to go extra mile to help student succeed

Great professor, 1 of the few @ FCC with a PhD. Genuinely cares about all his students, AND is respectful of those with different views. Though the class met only once a week, he learned EVERYONEs names and never forgot. If you\'re interested in the subject, take him. Otherwise you may not find the weekly chapter readings and write-ups worthwhile.

She is such a great instructor! She is very clear when she assigns homework and her quizes are open book! i got a lot from this class and she even helped me decide my major! Very caring and funny professor.
Seriously saved my life, i had to take remedial twice math and without this lady I would\'ve not passed my math course thank you so much!

I cannot say enough about Rios. Best prof I have ever had and I will remember him for the rest of my life. He changed my idea of sociology, and I\'ve never looked forward to going to lecture so much. He\'s is amazing. So smart, inspirational and just a stand-up guy.

Read the textbook. Give yourself at least 2 nights to do this before midterms and at least 3 before the final. He gives practice questions which end up on the test. Chris likes to illustrate concepts using stories from his own life, which is interesting to a certain point. Go to class. Unhelpful slides but useful lecture material.

I took this course to fulfill a grad school prerequisite. I\'ve never had a teacher so disorganized in my academic career. Deadlines he posted were for the previous semester. He randomly changed assignment/quiz due dates. Goes off on non-accounting tangents and hurries lecture. You\'re better off teaching yourself accounting than taking his course.

He\'s a pretty good professor. His paper isn\'t hard at all and the way he structures it makes it easier to complete. You must read every chapter of that textbook though because if you don\'t, you will struggle on his quizzes & tests. Goodluck!
Kaelin is really relaxed. He\'s very funny and keeps lectures interesting. No homework ever! The textbook isn\'t necessary.
Okay

I found some of the concepts confusing at first. She also seemed to go over some problems quickly or skip a few steps. She would answer questions we had and we always went over practice problems near the end of class which made the concepts much easier to understand.

Fantastic professor who cares about his students and wants them to succeed. Granted this class is a ton of work, but he makes it fun and gives every chance for the student to do well. I can guarantee if you go to class and do the work you will do well. It\'s reading heavy but the reading was enjoyable. Smart man - big heart. Class runs late haha!

Ms. Weston knows Calculus and enjoys teaching it. Her grading criteria are clear and her tests aren\'t easy, but she is fair and offers plenty of extra credit opportunity. Textbook is NOT used, but MyMathLab is used to submit all homework, with instant feedback and unlimited tries on each question.

Honestly, only great things can be said about her. She is truly interested in the subject which is one of the best things, but she is also a very fair grader. You will learn a lot and she makes is very interesting and fun. Nevertheless take the class seriously she will not just handout As, but at the same time it is very possible to get one.

I took his lecture early in the morning at 9AM which was tough because he is very monotone and boring. He goes through the lecture pretty quickly too, and chem is a lot to take in. Regardless, he is a great professor who is very knowledgable and helpful one-on-one. He knows his info thats for sure. Would recommend but maybe not early in the morning

Dr.Senter is awesome!! He sometimes tends to drift off topic BUT, when it comes to the nitty gritty he will test you like you\'re suppose to be tested and provides power points, test practice manuals, and homework examples. I truly enjoyed his class.

She\'s a very hard teacher, but if you want to improve, follow her lead. One thing i would note is that she needs to explain the structure of her essays before you turn them in. She had a tendency to forget that.
Terrible... Tests are so terrible, he just assumes you know what is being talked about in the question and doesn\'t explain anything. DONT TAKE FROM HIM!

She was extremely helpful and very clear. She made acct. seem easy, She goes over the information very well to where you will understand it. The quiz she gives you, comes straight off line, word for word. And the test are from problems out of the book or homework. Awesome professor!
He seems like the kind of guy you\'d want to have a beer with.

This teacher doesn\'t care if the students learn anything he just wants to get through the material. On the last test he said if you had a 63/100 thats good, so that means majority of the class did not do well. I have never heard a teacher say a 63 out of 100 is good. I wish I could drop the class but I have no other choice.

Her tests are a little difficult but if you listen and take good notes, you will do fine. You have two research assignments that are pretty simple and she grades fairly. She is energetic and gives a lot of examples.

VERY interesting class.she is practically in tears when talking about the Abe Lincoln... no lie.she absolutely loves this class which makes it enjoyable to listen to;however,it is 100% lecture &she talks VERY fast &writes NOTHING on the board.3 tests,all essay but she gives u the ?\'s ahead of time.only time u do work is to study for the tests. <3 h

i barely attended class and the lost exam grade i got was 81%, study guid was perfect, some things were drawn on board in class tho, so i missed some of those questions. fun easy, nice teacher. took forever to post grades and respond to emails.

Prof. Cameron is a very clear lecturer and has a pleasent and inviting style to her. It\'s been said that a person only truly understands something when they can explain it simply, and Angela Cameron has this covered well. That said, she covers a whole lot of information in a lecture, so be sure to do the readings if you want to keep up!

Once I started the first week of the class I knew it was going to be very difficult. The material is not taught thoroughly. Most of the class I have no idea what is going on. The tests are extremely hard, so hard no one in the class passes them hardly. I would not recommend this class to anyone unless your willing to self teach everything.

Lectures are sometimes boring, but very informative. Tests are based on what he says in lecture, a list of works handed out ahead of time and vocabulary. Very open to questions during and after class and helps in any way he can. Only two papers, which are very straightforward. Great professor.
I had her for both comp 1 and 2 online. she is very easy

I had this Russian professor for my ME 354 and for moonbuggy class. He is knowledgeable and smart, and very friendly. Helped me a lot. He has this accent ..but you get used to it by the end of the second week. His moonbuggy class made my life different and I recommended it to couple of kids. They seem to like it either

She\'s taking this class way too seriously. The tests are far too hard. The prof is unsympathetisc. If you really like speech, find a different professor. If you need an easy A then take something else.
Definitely a better choice than Porter. He can be moody, but he is overall a good guy.
witzlng is awkward. speaks too fast. can\'t understand him. doesn\'t really go in depth with the literature. i didn\'t like his class. had 3 papers each 5 pages each and like 3 tests.
This instructor does not like power points. She does a lot of writing. But that is not a bad thing. She explains everything in detail and gives great examples.

Jessica is a great professor. I was never interested in art, and after this class.. let\'s just say I have a new hobby. She is fun and energetic, you will never be bored in her class. I am not an art-sy person and I ended up getting an A because she just wants you to really try do the projects and always be there. Oh, and we didn\'t use a book!
I slacked off a bit and got a B+. Lots of extra credit. Easy teacher and class. Final was kinda hard though

Wonderful teacher. She encourages you to do your best. She is VERY smart & brings out the best in her students. She is willing to help you any time with anything you have a question on. She has to be the best English teacher Gateway has on staff ( and I have now had of them )
Easy online class

Ms. Gray is nice. Seems new to teaching. She does not spend much time lecturing & has no outline when she does. She barely covers 10% of the textbook. The student is on his own to learn the material. Quizzes & tests seem to be produced by the publisher. Class format is basically read, quiz, test. I would look for a more experienced instructor.

Mrs. Vaughn has lots of character, and if your not willing to pay attention or attend her class, you will be left behind! She is a fun and interesting professor that will go off on some random story or experience she has had. If your want a good grade, do not slack off in her class... She shows no mercy!
She was a very great teacher and very helpful! I highly recommend her!

Online . Chats all right, hard to hear, partly the system, also unclear speaking. Double negatives on final exam, but questions clear and fair on midterm. Double negatives difficult for ESL students who may be an A student but have a hard time with the wording of questions. Marking the essay portion stricter on final. Felt bad after MT good mark.

I took Nur 100. I ENJOYED the class- the quizes were difficult for me because I tend to "read" too much into the questions. Anytime you need questions answered in class or at home she is there.
